name: Dynamic Omaspaces
author: Murdi Althaf
description: Hyprland workspace pills that appear only for workspaces in use on the current monitor, each showing a Nerd Font icon for every open app. Ships icon rules for common apps and Omarchy web apps, and reads your own rules from a JSON file. Based on Omaspaces by Daniel Lobo.

barWidget.description: Pills only for workspaces in use on this monitor, with an icon per open app. Click to switch; scroll to cycle.

schema.label: Show app icons
schema.description: Draw a glyph for each open window's app inside its workspace pill.

schema.label: Show workspace numbers
schema.description: Show the workspace number. If app icons are also off, pills show numbers anyway.

schema.label: Max icons per workspace
schema.description: How many app icons a pill draws before folding the rest into a +N count.

schema.label: Active color
schema.description: Theme color used to highlight the active workspace.

schema.label: Compact spacing
schema.description: Tighten padding and gaps between pills.

schema.label: Custom icon rules file
schema.description: JSON file of [{"match": "regex", "icon": "glyph"}, ...] rules, matched against window class and title before the built-in list. Supports ~ and $HOME, and reloads when the file changes.
